tracks.title: Graveyard Sign-On
tracks.direction: Normal old-time announcer, distant AM tower sound, static bed, establishes the haunted broadcast without a crowd.

tracks.title: Coffin Lid Rag
tracks.direction: 1930s spooky rag / hillbilly swing instrumental, upright feel, creaky room energy, no modern country production.

tracks.title: Dead Air Interlude
tracks.direction: Short weak-signal instrumental, muffled old radio tone, sparse steel guitar and static, no big build.

tracks.title: Roaster Rattle
tracks.direction: Mechanical roastery rhythm, old rockabilly / steel guitar, dark playful Halloween machinery, vintage not modern.

tracks.title: The Town Goes Quiet
tracks.direction: Creatures, ghosts, goblins and beasts are moving away; town winds down after the night's escalation; relaxed end-of-show feeling with a normal announcer signoff.

tracks.title: Brew & Brews Radio ID
tracks.direction: 20–30 second normal announcer ID for Brew & Brews Coffee Roastery in Louisburg, Kansas; old tube-radio sound; no crowd.

tracks.title: Last Cup Before Dawn
tracks.direction: Lazy late-night vintage closer, warm tube-radio feel, restrained and sleepy, coffee roastery imagery without sounding like a cafe.

tracks.title: Werewolf Weather Break
tracks.direction: Normal announcer tries a werewolf howl, clears throat, says 'woof,' then gives a short spooky weather/signal update and returns to the show.
